note: The variables and warnings projections come from the scope tests: an acknowledged error stays withheld (old: variables == {key: None}, so only the named neighbour value is built), and the published warning carries the reviewed reason as its detail, at register level with no variable (old: warning.detail == case.decision.reason, variable_fqid None, register_fqid the register).
fails_if: the evidence guard in `resolve_source_scope` hashes a different record set than member 1003's own originals (for example every scope original rather than `guarded_originals` of the entry's refs), so an unchanged guarded entry is reported stale; or `acknowledged_diagnostic` (source_curation.py) lets an acknowledged identity error release its output, so 1.102 is built; or the acknowledged data warning publishes the issue's own detail instead of the entry's reason
